data.label: Druid
data.content: Day 1. The zombies are at the fence. The Pea family said they'd help — if I survive today.

data.label: Pea Waifu
data.content: You lived! Repeater and I will carry seeds for you now. Tomorrow the Sunflowers wake up.

data.label: Druid
data.content: Day 2. Sunflowers make sun. I need sun. We need sun.

data.label: Sunflower Waifu
data.content: Twin Sunflower sends her thanks. The Shrooms are… shy. They only come out at night.

data.label: Druid
data.content: Day 3. Puff, Scaredy, Fume, Gloom. And something bigger watching from the roof.

data.label: Shroom Waifu
data.content: Doom and Ice chose to stay quiet today. They are not like us. You will know them when the roof burns.

data.label: Druid
data.content: Three days survived. 297 to go for the three million. Fine. We feast tonight.

data.label: Druid
data.content: The lawn fell. Again. Same day, same zombies — go again.

data.label: Druid
data.content: Again. The Sunflowers believe in us. Probably.

data.label: Druid
data.content: Again. Even the Shrooms are nervous now.
